usage.reason: The source documents candidate-specific activity feeds, but no per-user last-active field, account-wide user activity log, or per-user usage report.

evidence.quote: Harvest uses Basic Auth over HTTPS for authentication.
API methods that return a collection of results are always paginated.
Harvest API requests for approved Greenhouse partners and customer-built custom integrations are limited to the amount specified in the returned X-RateLimit-Limit header, per 10 seconds.
The activity feed is the list of activities on a candidate's profile, including interviews, notes, and emails.
Custom Fields on the application object are only available to customers with Enterprise-level accounts.
Unauthenticated requests will return an HTTP 401 response.

The maximum page size for GET: List Users is not stated; pageSize 100 is a conservative default based on the documented default for other collection endpoints.
The source does not document how disabled or deactivated users are represented or whether the user list includes them.
The documented rate limit is 50 requests per 10 seconds; no per-minute equivalent or reset timestamp format is stated.
The only plan note applies to application custom fields; no plan requirement is stated for the Users endpoint.
